10 recommended acne treatment clinics in Osaka! Compare costs and treatment menus

"Even though I keep using over-the-counter medicines, my acne doesn't go away easily."

"I don't know which to choose, a dermatologist or a beauty clinic."

As mentioned above, many people may be confused about their treatment options.

There are many acne treatment clinics in Osaka, including dermatology and beauty clinics.From insurance medical treatment to free medical treatmentWe have a wide range of options available.

inflammation acneIf you want to treat acne scars, you should go to a dermatology clinic that is covered by insurance, and if you want to improve the unevenness of acne scars and pigmentation, you should go to a beauty clinic that offers free treatment.Choosing a clinic will become easier。

In this article, we will introduce clinics where you can consult about acne treatment in Osaka.10 selectionsWe will introduce you to the cost and treatment menu.

We will also explain treatments for each type of acne, how to use dermatology and beauty clinics, and the criteria for choosing a clinic.

Choose a clinic that suits your symptoms and goalsThis is the key to efficient treatment.

What you can learn from this article
  • Types of acne (white, black, red, cystic), causes, and how to choose treatment
  • Main treatment menus and reference costs available at clinics in Osaka
  • How to use dermatology and beauty clinics and choose according to symptoms

*Cosmetic treatments are, in principle, free treatment.

There are risks such as redness, swelling, pain, peeling, and pigmentation depending on the procedure, so please check the cost and indications at the time of your consultation.

Supervisor of this article

Yoshitomo Chihara

Director of Norris Beauty Clinic

Postdoctoral Researcher, Norris Cancer Center, University of Southern California;National Cancer Center PathologyHead of the club,Nara Prefectural Medical UniversityLecturer in Molecular Pathology,Saiseikai Chuwa HospitalAfter serving as head of the urology departmentnorris beauty clinicOpened a hospital.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

Knowing the types and causes of acne will expand your treatment options.

Acne is divided into different types depending on its appearance, and the causes and appropriate treatments vary for each type.

Even the early stages of whiteheads and blackheads are covered by insurance at dermatologists, and when inflammation has progressed.red acneYacystTherefore, it is important for the doctor to decide on an appropriate treatment plan.

Types of acne, causes and direction of treatment
  • The main cause of whiteheads and blackheads is clogged pores.
  • Red acne and yellow acne are inflammation caused by the proliferation of acne bacteria.
  • Cysts and indurations are severe acne in which inflammation reaches deep into the skin.

By knowing what stage your acne is at,What kind of medical institution and treatment method should you choose?This makes it easier to judge.

Before visiting a clinic, be sure to understand the characteristics and causes of each type.

The main cause of whiteheads and blackheads is clogged pores.

Whiteheads and blackheads are classified as the early stages of acne that do not involve inflammation.

Whiteheads occur when sebum and dead skin cells clog pores and block the exit.

Because the pores are closed, sebum is not exposed to the outside air, making it appear white or skin-colored.

Blackheads are caused by clogged sebum coming into contact with air when the pores are open.oxidationIt can be said that it has turned black.

Differences and characteristics between white acne and black acne
  • white acne: Pores are closed and sebum is clogged, resulting in a white to skin-colored appearance (closed comedones)
  • black acne: With pores open, sebum oxidizes and turns black (open comedones)
  • Both are in the early stages without inflammation, and early treatment may prevent deterioration.
  • Treatment drug: Adapalene/benzoyl peroxide combination topical drug (covered by insurance)

Neither is inflamed, so if you start care at this stage,Easily prevents progression to red acne and cystsIt will be.

In dermatology, it has the effect of softening dead skin cells in pores in order to remove the blockage itself called comedo.adapaleneYabenzoyl peroxideTopical medicines containing the following will be prescribed.

Treatment for whiteheads and blackheads can be started within the scope of insurance treatment, so it is a less expensive option to consider first by visiting a dermatologist.

Along with daily care such as washing and moisturizing your face, be sure to visit your doctor as soon as possible.

Red acne and yellow acne are inflammation caused by the proliferation of acne bacteria.

Red acne uses sebum clogged in pores as a source of nutrition.acne bacteriaThis is a condition in which the cells proliferate and the inflammation spreads to the surrounding tissue.

P. acnes is a type of bacteria that always lives on the skin, and it has the property of actively multiplying in the oxygen-poor environment of the pores.

When inflammation occurs, the area around the pores becomes red and swollen, and may feel painful when touched.

Yellow acne is caused by further progression of red acne and inflammation.Pusis trapped inside the pores.

Progression and treatment options for red and yellow acne
  • Red acne: acne bacteria grows, causing redness and swelling around the area and pain.
  • Yellow acne: Further progresses and pus accumulates (the surface is yellowish white)
  • If you crush it on your own, there is a risk of pigmentation and unevenness remaining.
  • Dermatology: Topical medications such as benzoyl peroxide and adapalene, and antibiotics as necessary (covered by insurance)
  • Beauty clinic: Combination of chemical peeling and laser is also possible

The surface appears yellowish-white because the color of the pus is transparent, and the degree of inflammation is stronger than that of red pimples.

If you pop red or yellow acne on your own, the inflammation may worsen or acne scars may appear.Risk of pigmentation and unevenness remainingThere is.

Depending on the degree of inflammation, your dermatologist will combine topical medications such as benzoyl peroxide and antibiotics.

At beauty clinics, you can also choose a treatment that combines chemical peeling and laser, so please consult with your doctor about the suitability and cost of free treatment.

Cysts and indurations are severe acne in which inflammation reaches deep into the skin.

cystandindurationis a serious condition of acne in which inflammation reaches deep layers of the skin.

A cyst is a sac-like structure that is filled with pus or fluid inside the skin, and the surface is red and swollen, often accompanied by severe pain.

Induration refers to a condition in which the skin tissue becomes fibrous and hardened like a lump due to inflammation.

In both cases, the walls of the pores are torn and inflammation occurs in the surrounding area.dermal layerBecause it is widespread, it is difficult to treat with over-the-counter drugs and requires treatment by a doctor at a dermatologist or beauty clinic.

Treatment approach for cysts and indurations
  • dermatology:Use topical drugs and oral antibiotics, and consider local injection into the cyst if necessary.
  • beauty clinic:Improve the unevenness of acne scars with fractional laser dermapen
  • If left untreated, crater-like depressions and scars tend to remain, so early diagnosis is important.

If cysts and indurations are left untreated, they may persist even after the inflammation subsides.Crater-shaped depressions and scars are likely to remain.It will be.

If your symptoms are severe, please see a doctor as soon as possible.

Dermatologists use topical drugs and antibiotics as needed, and for inflamed cysts, doctors may consider local steroid injections into the cyst.

If you want to improve the unevenness of acne scars after the inflammation has subsided,fractional laserYaderma penPlease consider consulting with a beauty clinic as treatment options include cosmetic treatments such as:

Main treatment menus available for acne treatment in Osaka

Acne treatments available at clinics in Osaka include:Drug therapy covered by insuranceWe offer a wide range of services, from laser treatments to free treatment.

The menu to choose differs depending on the stage of symptoms and the purpose of treatment, soTreatment suitable for your conditionIt is important to understand.

Types and characteristics of treatment menus available in Osaka
  • Ointments and oral medications covered by insurance: Effective for mild to moderate inflammatory acne
  • Chemical peel: unclogs pores and stimulates metabolism
  • Isotretinoin: Suppresses sebum secretion and treats severe acne
  • Dermapen/Laser: Improves unevenness and pigmentation of acne scars

There are two main options depending on whether you want to suppress inflammatory acne or improve existing acne scars.

While drug treatments such as ointments and oral medications are covered by insurance and can be started at a reduced cost, free treatment such as chemical peels and lasers are not available.Improvement of skin condition and acne scarsIt is suitable for those who aim to

Knowing the outline of the treatment menu will make it easier to consult with your doctor during your first visit.

Ointments and oral medications covered by insurance are effective for mild to moderate symptoms.

Insurance-covered drug therapy is used by many dermatologists as a starting point in the treatment of inflammatory acne.

In the ointment,adapalene(Product name: Differin) and benzoyl peroxide are typical examples, and they work to suppress inflammation while removing keratin plugs that clog pores.

Oral medicines include antibiotics (such as minocycline and doxycycline) that have antibacterial effects against P. acnes, the bacteria that causes acne.

For medical treatments covered by insurance, the co-payments for consultation fees and drug costs vary depending on the patient's contribution ratio and prescription details.

For mild to moderate inflammatory acne, there are many people whose symptoms can be greatly improved with just drug therapy covered by insurance.

However, if antibiotics are used for a long time,resistant bacteriaPlease use this medicine for the period and dose as directed by your doctor.

Chemical peels unclog pores and stimulate metabolism

Chemical peeling is a treatment that removes dead skin cells by applying acidic ingredients such as glycolic acid or lactic acid to the skin.

By removing clogged pores and excess sebum,Skin environment that is less prone to acneYou can expect the effect of adjusting the.

Treatment time per sessionAbout 15-30 minutesThe price varies depending on the drug used and the scope of treatment, with examples of prices ranging from 5,000 to 15,000 yen per treatment.

Basic information about chemical peels
  • Treatment time:About 15-30 minutes per session
  • Estimated cost: Approximately 5,000 to 15,000 yen per session (this is an example price and varies depending on the drug and treatment scope)
  • Recommended pace: Consult with your doctor regarding the number of treatments and treatment intervals.
  • Points to note:After treatment, the barrier function decreases, so take thorough measures against UV rays.

Rather than seeking dramatic changes in a single treatment, the condition of your skin will stabilize by continuing the treatment multiple times, about once a month.
After chemical peeling, the skin's barrier function will be temporarily reduced, so please take thorough measures against UV rays and follow your doctor's instructions when washing your face and bathing on the day of the treatment.

There are cases where you should avoid treatment when acne inflammation is strong, so be sure to tell your doctor about your current skin condition when you visit.

Isotretinoin is an unapproved oral drug being considered for severe acne.

Isotretinoinis an oral drug that is classified as a vitamin A derivative and has the effect of suppressing sebaceous gland function and sebum secretion.

Improvement has been reported in severe cases such as cysts and indurated acne.Those who have not seen improvement with other treatmentsIt is often prescribed.

The isotretinoin preparation “Isotrex Capsules 8mg and 16mg”, which was approved in Japan on June 19, 2026, is indicated for the treatment of neuroblastoma after high-dose chemotherapy.This does not mean that it is indicated for acne treatment or that the acne torrent mentioned in the article has been approved in Japan.。

Prescriptions for acne are not covered by public medical insurance, and you will need to confirm the total of consultation fees, drug fees, and test fees.

Points to note before taking isotretinoin
  • It cannot be used by pregnant women and must be avoided while breastfeeding (risk of teratogenicity, etc.)
  • Contraception is required while taking the drug and for a certain period after it is finished.
  • Side effects: Dry lips and skin, impact on liver function
  • Regular blood tests are required while taking the medication.
  • Cost: Varies depending on the type and dose of the drug (please also check the consultation fee and blood collection fee)

Isotretinoin is teratogenic (effects on the fetus), so it cannot be used by pregnant women and should be avoided while breastfeeding.

Contraception is necessary while you are taking this medicine and for a certain period after you finish taking it, so please ask your doctor for detailed instructions before prescribing this medicine.

Side effects may include dry lips and skin, and effects on liver function, so do not take regular medication while taking the medication.blood testYou are required to receive

If you have been suffering from severe acne for a long time, please consult a clinic that sells isotretinoin.

*The use of isotretinoin for acne treatment is not approved in Japan.

It is a free medical treatment, and even under the supervision of a doctor, care must be taken to avoid serious effects on the fetus, dry lips and skin, liver dysfunction, and lipid abnormalities.

Dermapen and laser can be expected to be effective in reducing the unevenness of acne scars and pigmentation.

Dermapen and laser treatment are not for the acne itself, but for the residue that remains after it has healed.Improves unevenness and pigmentationThis is a treatment aimed at.

derma penuses ultra-fine needles to create tiny holes in the skin to stimulate collagen production, making crater-like dents less noticeable.

Fractional laser is a system that promotes skin regeneration by applying thermal stimulation deep into the skin, and in addition to improving unevenness, it can also treat redness of acne scars and brown pigmentation.

As a reference price for beauty clinics, per derma penAround 15,000 to 40,000 yen, per fractional laserAround 20,000 to 50,000 yenHere are some example prices.

Each treatment often requires multiple visits to the hospital, so it is best to first have a consultation to create a treatment plan that suits your skin condition.

Effective treatments vary depending on the type of acne scars (dimpling, redness, pigmentation), so there are many clinics in Osaka that offer plans that combine multiple treatments.

Choose a dermatologist or beauty clinic based on your acne condition and purpose.

Dermatology and beauty clinics are not simply superior or inferior;Current symptoms and purpose of treatmentIt can be used depending on.

If you think about it from two perspectives: whether your priority is to suppress inflammation, or whether you want to improve existing acne scars, you will naturally know which one to choose.

How to use dermatology/cosmetic clinics and the flow of treatment
  • Dermatology covered by insurance: For people who want to treat inflammatory acne at a low cost
  • Beauty clinic: For people who want to improve acne scars through free medical treatment
  • In severe cases: Procedure for moving to a beauty clinic after diagnosis at a dermatologist

The fee structure for insurance treatment and free treatment differs, so if you organize your plans, including your budget, you will be able to sort out any questions you may have before your visit.

Dermatology covered by insurance is for people who want to treat inflammatory acne at a low cost.

Dermatology covered by insurance treats red acne, pus-filled acne, etc.inflammatory conditionsIt is a suitable option for the treatment of

The amount you will have to pay will vary depending on the treatment and medication, and depending on your symptoms, you may be prescribed topical medications or oral antibiotics.

A typical example of ointment isAdapalene (Differin)There are gels containing benzoyl peroxide and benzoyl peroxide, which can be expected to have the effect of suppressing inflammation while unclogging pores.

Medications often prescribed by dermatologists covered by insurance
  • Topical medicine: Gel containing adapalene (differin) and benzoyl peroxide
  • Oral medicine: Minocycline, doxycycline (antibiotics)
  • Visiting pace:Generally once or twice a month
  • cost: Varies depending on examination/prescription (prescribed co-payment rate if covered by insurance)

Based on the examination, medical institutions can consider treatment plans, including prescription drugs such as adapalene and benzoyl peroxide.

If you want to treat inflamed acne while keeping costs down, please consider visiting a dermatologist covered by insurance first.

The cost varies depending on the type of treatment; for chemical peels,Approximately 5,000 to 15,000 yen per time, when it comes to fractional lasersAround 20,000 to 50,000 yen per sessionis the standard.

Since multiple treatments are often required, be sure to confirm the total cost during your initial consultation.

Consultation fees at beauty clinics vary by clinic, so please check the consultation fees and test fees before making a reservation.

The condition of acne scars differs from person to person, so be sure to choose a clinic where a doctor will examine your skin condition and recommend an appropriate menu before treatment.

If the symptoms are severe, patients are often referred to a beauty clinic after being diagnosed by a dermatologist.

like cysts or indurationssevere acneIn many cases, patients first receive treatment to calm inflammation at a dermatologist, and then, once the condition has calmed down, they proceed to a beauty clinic.

If you undergo laser or light therapy while the inflammation remains, the irritation to your skin will become too strong.Risk of worsening symptomsTherefore, it is important to take steps.

Is acne treatment covered by insurance?

inflammation acneTreatment may be covered by insurance.

Can the unevenness of acne scars be improved with treatment?

The unevenness (crater-like depression) of acne scars can be expected to improve with appropriate treatment.

However, since the degree of improvement varies depending on the depth and extent of the unevenness, it is standard practice for the doctor to evaluate the current situation at the time of your consultation and then decide on a treatment plan.

Some clinics are able to address deeper irregularities by combining a procedure called subcision, in which the skin of the sunken area is peeled off from the inside with a needle and lifted up.
